## v0.2.0 - 2026-09-29

### Added

* Release management: `CHANGELOG.md` is generated by changie from per-PR fragments, and releases are cut through a Release PR workflow that bumps every version location and publishes unsigned macOS, Linux and Windows bundles as a draft GitHub release.

### Fixed

* A second launch now focuses the running instance instead of starting a duplicate (tray icon included)
